description: A loop start whose mode is outside the closed vocabulary simple|standard|poc is a REFUSAL, not an infrastructure failure (S19 T7): the daemon understood the call and declined it. The narrow surface answers 409 refused for this class, never 503-retry — a resend of the same junk mode fails identically.

data.means: modes select which lanes the blueprint's steps actually run; an unknown mode would silently run the wrong subset
